The '''Tulrus Isle Bridge''' was a bridge located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="SWG:TBFM" /> It was built by the [[Klegger Corporation]] long before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="SWG:TSFM" /> to connect the [[Berken's Flow/Legends|Berken's Flow]] region to the [[Tulrus Nesting Grounds]].<ref name="SWG:TBFM" /> The bridge was originally formed out of steel but years in the harsh Mustafarian environment had coated it with volcanic ash and rock so that it resembled a natural rock formation by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TCFM">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Crystal Flats Markers|Mustafar}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tulrus Isle Bridge was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TBFM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Tulrus Isle Bridge was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TBFM" />
